ghi_chu.mo_ta: A tiny flag on a pole at the edge of the left camp strip looks like a red-and-white Union Jack with a diagonal saltire. It is too small to be sure of the design.
ghi_chu.ly_do: If it is a Union Jack, the version with the St Patrick's saltire dates from the 1801 union with Ireland. In 1779 the British Union flag had only the crosses of St George and St Andrew.

ghi_chu.mo_ta: A red-white-red horizontal ensign on the stern of the large ship at right.
ghi_chu.ly_do: It does not match the flags a ship at Gibraltar would fly in 1779. These would be the British Red Ensign or the Spanish naval ensign. The design is also too small to identify, so this is a weak finding.
